subject: O Level E-Math
title: Vectors in a parallelogram
question:
ABCD is a parallelogram, and E lies on CD produced such that CD : CE = 1 : 2. M is the midpoint of AD. N is a point on BC such that BN : BC = 1 : 4. BN = a and CD = b.
Express, as simply as possible, in terms of a and/or b, (i) AM, (ii) BM, (iii) BE.
referenceNote: The original figure from the exam paper.

scene: The ratios in the question are given directly to the renderer, so E, M and N land in exactly the right places.
tikz: A is placed using the other three corners, so the shape is always a parallelogram.
svg: The arrowheads on a and b were calculated by hand.

figure:
Parallelogram ABCD with B on the left, C at the top, D on the right and A at the bottom.
CD is extended beyond D to E, so that CE is twice CD.
N is on BC with BN a quarter of BC. M is the midpoint of AD.
Draw the lines ND and BM.
Show vector a along BN and vector b along CD, each with an arrow in the middle of the line and a bold letter beside it.
Label A, B, C, D, E, M and N.
